result.text:
### Q1
No. SQLite was rejected because ops backs up the JSON file with a nightly rsync that diffs plain-text files, so the store stays plain-text JSON.

### Q2
Yes, `src/legacy/` must not be touched, because the platform team's sync job overwrites it every Monday. Also, `docs/erp-api.md` belongs to the ERP team, so leave it alone.

### Q3
The signature goes in a top-level `sig` field in the body. It is the hex HMAC-SHA256 over the compact JSON without `sig`, and it is always the last key. A header was not used because the ERP's API gateway strips custom `X-` headers. The summary doesn't say a header was actually tried and failed, only that it was ruled out for this reason.

### Q4
Port 9911. It moved from 8080 after the October infra move, but `config/default.json` still says 8080.

### Q5
The `message` is in German, because it shows up verbatim in the packers' UI. The `code` is English `SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE`. This applies to all new errors, and the existing English messages were left as they were.

### Q6
Holidays are hardcoded and offline in `src/services/holidays.ts`, which has the 13 Austrian holidays for 2026 and 2027. `isBusinessDay` uses it, and dates outside those years fall back to weekends only. The summary doesn't state why it was built offline, only that it is hardcoded. 2028 must be added before the end of next year.

### Q7
No. The ERP answers 422 to any array, so only single event objects work.

### Q8
No new npm packages, dev ones included. Each one needs a security review of about six weeks, so use Node built-ins only.

### Q9
It was measured but not added. The ETA is about 2 ms of a roughly 7 ms handler call for a 5,000-shipment store at `limit=500`. QA later reported a stale-cache bug and the user said to remove the memoization completely, but no such code exists in this tree. Caching ETAs is off the table.

### Q10
There are 3 attempts in total, with a fixed 30 s pause and no backoff. Only network errors and 5xx responses are retried. It stops if a retry would start 120 s or more after the first attempt, because the ERP deduplicates by `event_id` only within 2 minutes.

### Q11
Recipient name, address and phone must never be logged, because of GDPR and the data protection officer's audit. Shipment IDs and tracking numbers are fine. The optional event `note` is also kept out of the ERP payload because free text could contain personal data.

### Q12
Yes, `emits webhook on delivered` in `test/events.test.ts` (OPS-412, owned by the platform team). If it goes red, rerun once and don't edit the test.

### Q13
Only carrier ATP is validated strictly, using the UPU S10 check digit from `docs/carriers.md`. A failure returns 400 `INVALID_TRACKING_NUMBER` with a German message. DHL, DPD, GLS and UPS stay loose on purpose. `POST /import` uses the same validator, so bad ATP rows are reported per line.

### Q14
Nothing has been built. `fs.watch` stays silent on staging because the config is a Docker bind mount from a Windows host. `fs.watchFile`, which polls, works.

### Q15
Yes, `GET /shipments/:id`. Mobile app v2.3 parses it strictly and crashes on unknown or missing fields, and their next release is in January. A test pins its exact key order.
